name: Wakeshift
description: Wakes OpenClaw sessions when an app they watch through Wakeshift sends something. Messages arrive as outside information, never as the user.

cliCommands.name: wakeshift
cliCommands.description: Wakeshift's plugin: undo what it turned on (reset)

issuer.description: The Wakeshift whose beacons the plugin trusts. Unset: Wakeshift's own service, https://app.wakeshift.ai; the install command for another Wakeshift sets it.

allowNetworkHooks.description: The user agreed to OpenClaw's hooks endpoint while the gateway listens beyond this computer (its bind isn't loopback): the hooks share its listener. Without it the plugin doesn't turn hooks on there. The install command sets it after the user's yes; openclaw wakeshift reset removes it.

heartbeatTarget.description: Unused: from the earlier heartbeat wake. A woken turn's reply now goes to the channel the conversation last spoke on.
